meta.name: eli5
meta.description: WHAT: Explains a codebase, a folder, a feature, a command or a pull request to someone who knows nothing about it, as a PR Lens canvas whose walkthrough builds the picture one part at a time. WHEN: /eli5 <thing>, or asked to explain code simply, for a beginner, a new hire, a non-engineer, or 'like I'm five'. KEYWORDS: eli5, explain like I'm five, explain simply, beginner, onboarding, walkthrough, diagram, PR Lens

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把看不懂的代码或改动,一步步讲成图解让人听懂
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚接手陌生代码库,或要给新人、非技术同事讲清代码
copy.tagline_en: Walk someone through unfamiliar code or a change, one part at a time, as a picture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just inherited unfamiliar code or must explain code to newcomers

howto.what: 它会用一句人话说明某个代码库、文件夹、功能、命令或 PR 在做什么，再生成一块 PR Lens 画布：从两个框开始，一步步长出完整的图，最后给你一个可打开的链接。
howto.when: 输入 /eli5 加对象，或要求把代码讲给初学者、新人、非工程师听，或说「像讲给五岁小孩」时触发。

say.text: /eli5 这个文件夹是做什么的
say.note: 会画出逐步生长的图，并给出播放链接

say.text: 把这段代码讲给完全不懂技术的人听
say.note: 从两个框开始，一块一块铺开

say.text: 像讲给五岁小孩一样解释这个 pull request
say.note: 画完后只回复一句话和链接

howto.what_en: It states in one plain sentence what a codebase, folder, feature, command or PR does, then builds a PR Lens canvas that grows one part at a time, and gives you a link to open.
howto.when_en: Triggered by /eli5 <thing>, or when you ask to explain code simply for a beginner, a new hire or a non-engineer, or 'like I'm five'.

say_en.note: Draws a growing canvas and returns a play link

say_en.text: Explain this code to someone who knows nothing about it
say_en.note: Starts with two boxes, then grows the picture

say_en.text: Explain this pull request like I'm five
say_en.note: Replies with one sentence and the link
